results.legal_security_type: American Depositary Shares evidenced by ADRs, representing BT Group ordinary shares
results.source_documents: BT issuer listing history; SEC filing; SEC Form 20-F; Citibank depositary-receipt program record
results.factual_findings: BT states that its ordinary shares were also listed on the NYSE in the form of American Depositary Shares through September 2019. SEC materials identify ISIN US05577E1010 as American Depositary Shares and state that one ADS represented five BT Group ordinary shares. The predecessor British Telecommunications ADR program record for CUSIP 111021408 identifies an ADR and documents the successor BT Group NYSE CUSIP 05577E101.
results.identity_transition_analysis: CUSIP 05577E101 is the decision-period BT Group ADS/ADR security. CUSIP 111021408 is a predecessor British Telecommunications ADR identifier terminated years before the canonical interval and linked by the depositary to successor CUSIP 05577E101. The remaining legacy CUSIP 111021200 is historical identity metadata; inability to fully bind that pre-canonical identifier does not create factual type uncertainty for the decision-period security. No legal-type transition is established within 2008-01-04/2019-09-19.
results.contradiction_search: Searched issuer, SEC, and depositary materials for preferred, warrant, unit, or other non-common treatment of the decision-period NYSE security; all authoritative decision-period evidence identifies ADS/ADR interests in ordinary shares.
